note: Published images the security lane scans BY DIGEST (issue #2706). An `engine`+`variant` entry resolves its CURRENT pinned tag through scripts/engine_image.py at scan time; a `ref` entry is scanned as named. The registry index digest is read per scan and the scanner runs against `ref@sha256:...` — no stale digest literals live here. The image scan flows through the same security-verdict policy and security-issues path as the tree scans; the lane gates only its own events (data/security-policy.json), never a merge.
